subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: How do you say “We stayed in a campsite by the sea”?
options: Os alojasteis en un camping junto al mar
Nos alojamos en un camping junto al mar
Nos alojamos en un camping junto a la montaña
Nos alojamos en un hotel junto al mar
questions.explain: “Nos alojamos” = “we stayed”, “un camping” = campsite and “junto al mar” = by the sea.

questions.q: What does “la planta baja” mean?
questions.explain: “La planta baja” means “the ground floor”.

questions.q: What does “doblar a la derecha” mean?
questions.explain: “Doblar a la derecha” means “to turn right”.

questions.q: What does “al extranjero” mean in “viajar al extranjero”?
questions.explain: “El extranjero” means “abroad / foreign country”, so “viajar al extranjero” = “to travel abroad”.

questions.q: Which means “I'd recommend visiting the old town”?
questions.explain: “El casco antiguo” means “the old town”, and “recomendaría” is the conditional “I'd recommend”.

questions.q: What does 'el medio ambiente' mean?
questions.explain: 'El medio ambiente' is the fixed term for 'the environment' (nature).

questions.q: What does “sigue todo recto” mean when giving directions?
questions.explain: “Seguir todo recto” means “to go straight on”.

questions.q: What does “la estación” mean in “la estación de tren”?
questions.explain: “La estación de tren” means “the train station” (“la estación” can also mean “season”).

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to book a double room'?
options: Me gustaría reservar una habitación doble
Me gusta reservar una habitación doble
Me gustaría reservar una habitación individual
Me gustaría recordar una habitación doble
questions.explain: 'Reservar' = 'to book' and 'doble' = 'double'; 'recordar' (to remember) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: What does 'el alojamiento' mean?
questions.explain: 'El alojamiento' means 'accommodation' (where you stay); 'alojarse' = 'to stay/lodge'.

questions.q: What does “el barrio” mean?
questions.explain: “El barrio” means “the neighbourhood/district”.

questions.q: How do you say “The flight was cancelled because of the weather”?
options: El vuelo se cancela a causa del tiempo
El vuelo salió a causa del tiempo
El viaje se canceló a causa del tiempo
El vuelo se canceló a causa del tiempo
questions.explain: “El vuelo” = the flight, “se canceló” = was cancelled and “a causa del tiempo” = because of the weather.

questions.q: What does “el alojamiento” mean?
questions.explain: “El alojamiento” means “the accommodation” where you stay.

questions.q: What does “la playa” mean?
questions.explain: “La playa” means “the beach”.

questions.q: What does “una zona peatonal” mean?
questions.explain: “Peatonal” relates to “peatón” (pedestrian), so “una zona peatonal” = “a pedestrian area”.

questions.q: How do you say “My house has four bedrooms”?
questions.explain: “El dormitorio” = bedroom, so “cuatro dormitorios” = four bedrooms.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'The plane is delayed'?
questions.explain: 'Llevar retraso' means 'to be delayed', so 'El avión lleva retraso' = 'The plane is delayed'.

questions.q: What does “marearse” mean when travelling?
questions.explain: “Marearse” means “to feel sick/dizzy”, e.g. travel sickness.

questions.q: Which means “In my town there is a leisure centre and a library”?
options: En mi ciudad hay un polideportivo y una biblioteca
En mi ciudad había un polideportivo y una biblioteca
En mi ciudad hay un polideportivo y una librería
En mi ciudad hay una librería y una biblioteca
questions.explain: “El polideportivo” = sports/leisure centre and “la biblioteca” = library (“librería” is a bookshop, a false friend).

questions.q: Which sentence means “I have to change trains in Madrid”?
options: Tengo que coger el tren a Madrid
Tengo que cambiar dinero en Madrid
Tengo que hacer transbordo en Madrid
Tengo que perder el tren en Madrid
questions.explain: “Hacer transbordo” means “to change (trains/buses)”, so the first option is correct.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I live in a flat in the city centre”?
options: Vivo en un piso en el centro de la ciudad
Vivo en un piso en las afueras
Vivo en una casa en el campo
Vives en un piso en el centro de la ciudad
questions.explain: “Un piso” = a flat and “el centro de la ciudad” = the city centre.

questions.q: What does “hacer cola” mean?
questions.explain: “Hacer cola” is an idiom meaning “to queue / stand in line”.
